pages.title: Ender Arrow
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bow, Crossbow$(br2)§lEffect: §r When the arrow hits a creature, the shooter teleports in front of it. Hitting a block does nothing and does not consume the cooldown. Cooldown: 3 seconds.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
